name: Reliability: launch, load, one turn, save, reload, exit

steps.code: local r=GameInfo.GlobalParameters['JAC_POC_BUNDLE0_VERSION']; if not r or tostring(r.Value)~='1' then error('minimal mod database missing') end; local s=Game:GetProperty('JAC_POC_BUNDLE0_STATE'); if type(s)~='table' or type(s.FirstTurn)~='number' or type(s.LastTurn)~='number' or type(s.TurnsSeen)~='number' then error('invalid initial mod state') end; JAC_RELIABILITY_START_TURN=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(); JAC_RELIABILITY_START_SEEN=s.TurnsSeen; return tostring(JAC_RELIABILITY_START_TURN)

if Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()~=JAC_RELIABILITY_START_TURN+1 then error('must advance exactly one turn') end; local s=Game:GetProperty('JAC_POC_BUNDLE0_STATE'); if type(s)~='table' or type(s.FirstTurn)~='number' or type(s.LastTurn)~='number' or type(s.TurnsSeen)~='number' then error('minimal mod script state missing') end; if s.LastTurn~=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() or s.TurnsSeen~=JAC_RELIABILITY_START_SEEN+1 then error('minimal mod turn handler did not advance exactly once') end; return tostring(Game.GetCurrentGameTurn())..'|'..tostring(s.FirstTurn)..'|'..tostring(s.LastTurn)..'|'..tostring(s.TurnsSeen)

local s=Game:GetProperty('JAC_POC_BUNDLE0_STATE'); if type(s)~='table' or type(s.FirstTurn)~='number' or type(s.LastTurn)~='number' or type(s.TurnsSeen)~='number' or s.LastTurn~=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() then error('invalid minimal mod state after reload') end; return tostring(Game.GetCurrentGameTurn())..'|'..tostring(s.FirstTurn)..'|'..tostring(s.LastTurn)..'|'..tostring(s.TurnsSeen)
